proposedEvidence.description: BrigTimer source ports and Security operating credentials.
Start signal begins timer; Timer signal completes or cancels it.
Native Open and Close sinks invoke door operations; their presence does not bypass all door operating conditions.
AutoClose signal disables automatic closing until the airlock closes again.
Morgue and Crematorium use EntityStorage.enteringOffset 0,-1; native profiles do not impose a TEG-like gas hookup.
Storage opening rejects obstructed entering offset; ejection rotates this offset into the world.
Cremation requires closed storage with contents and blocks opening while active.
ComputerBodyScanner lacks dedicated medical-scanner/health-analyzer binding components in this native prototype.
